title: Ducktape Assets set
description: Authored description of one set: one repository, one licence story, one version line. Lives at the root of the set repository as set.yaml. Measurable facts are never typed here; the build generates them into manifest.json.

id.description: Set identifier. Equals the repository suffix and the package suffix. Permanent.

summary.description: One sentence saying what the set contains and where it comes from. Shown in the index README and the gallery.

kind.description: authored: made by the author (including AI-assisted work). historical: extracted from a documented source object; every asset needs provenance. imported: legacy material whose origin was not recorded; provenance may be null.

author.description: Account responsible for the set. Agents act on its behalf.

maintainer.description: Where to reach the maintainer: a URL (issue tracker) or an email.

license.description: Artwork licence for every asset of the set unless an asset overrides it.

artwork.description: SPDX identifier (CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, …) or a custom identifier defined in LICENSES.md.

notes.description: Attribution line or any condition a consumer must know.

period.description: Coverage: period of the artwork, for example '14th century'. Inherited by assets.

region.description: Coverage: region of origin, for example 'Flanders'. Inherited by assets.

style.description: Coverage: style or medium, for example 'illuminated manuscript'. Inherited by assets.

origin.description: Set-level provenance. A historical set made from one object names the holding institution and object; a historical set spanning several holdings (an artist's loose prints) names neither and every asset's provenance does; authored sets name the method and the reference sets.

references.description: Other set ids used as visual references.

created.description: Date the set was started, YYYY-MM-DD.

tags.description: Free tags for the set as a whole.

method.description: How the artwork was produced from its source.
